scope: Diagnostic on the two named phrases in the previously inspected synthetic validation set. Reserved testing and independent audio are excluded.
selection: All original Hey Mix and Hey Next validation sources in the existing equal-mean report and all four renders. Preserve quiet and false activation variants within each source; engine and speaker metadata retained.
primary: At the frozen strict equal-mean threshold, inspect exact phone sequences of false clips and their quiet same-source controls. For Hey Mix report unprompted /m/ and for Hey Next report /t/ at CTC mean spike confidence >= .5; always retain full spans.
secondary: Repeat the descriptive readout for clips that both member models triggered at their fixed individual points. All counts are views; same-source views are not independent.
limits: An unprompted phoneme decoder gives evidence of a cue in the audio, not proof of the human-perceived pronunciation, the acoustic source of a cue, or true phone boundaries.

The waveform with its original lead and augmentation is rebuilt and checked against its cached MicroFrontend features. Phoneme decoding is on original WAV and a speech-centered crop of that render, not the entire stream.
No thresholds, labels, model weights or device settings are changed. No playback or board operation.
